title: Smarter shared prop textures
summary: Garage props reuse repeated surfaces and give visible details more texture space.
notes: Stack crate panels, barrel facets, tyre tread and hub faces instead of allocating duplicate islands.
Combine the car body and all wheels into one 128x128 atlas and material with mirrored sides and shared glass.
Pack rotated islands, shrink underside budgets and repack retained high-resolution paintings for sharper visible details.
